title: No beauty profile so no way to know what is good individually.
text:
Honestly didn't like the July box as a whole. Only 2 out of 6 items I'll use....

1st The liquid matte Huda was awesome quality but the shade was bright reddish orange which is not a color I would ever wear, No filters or flash used to take the picture. I really liked the quality. Wish it was a color that would match my skin..
2nd. The Kay Ali Vanilla smelled amazing
3rd. The Tonymoly 24k gold mask. I never use masks. My skin is sensitive so I don't bother trying any more.
4th. The Huda false eyelashes. Though look gorgeous, I never wear false eyelashes and they don't come with glue or tools to handle them for people who have never used any either.
5th. Ouai texturing hairspray. I don't use hair spray or any products similar in my hair at all. Just wash and other blow dry a couple minutes in the front area.
6th. HangoveRx Replenishing Face Primer. I love this stuff. And I've had their products before and they are great.

They left a scratch off card to see 4 items that will be in the August box and I only like one of them and I already own it..... So I cancelled the subscription immediately. Also I contacted the seller and asked about a beauty profile so the products could be to my skin/hair type. They stated that they don't do that. Just random products..... So if you like completely surprise colors and such you might like this. It's just not for me.
label: negative
